newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Nov 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Nov 6.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page:
WASHINGTON - President Clinton became the first Democrat since Franklin Roosevelt to win reelection to the White House, boosted by a growing economy and rising public confidence.

LITTLE ROCK, ARKANSAS - President Clinton, at age 50, for the first time becomes free to act without calculating how his decisions will affect his political viability, and the question is whether he will reveal himself in a different and truer way.
WASHINGTON - Hot battles spiced the battle for control of the Senate.
WASHINGTON - Democrats and Republicans were locked in a close battle for control of the House of Representatives lastnight, ending a contentious election season.
WASHINGTON - Virginia Republican John Warner retained his seat in the U.S. Senate, according to media projections.
